API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the catch recording backend API for this stage.

ENTRA_CLIENT_ID.description: Application (client) ID of the Microsoft Entra External ID app registration for this stage (see ADR-0022). Required: false until real per-stage values are supplied by the Entra tenant team — revisit then.

ENTRA_TENANT_SUBDOMAIN.description: Subdomain of the Microsoft Entra External ID (CIAM) tenant for this stage, e.g. "contoso" for contoso.ciamlogin.com (see ADR-0022). Required: false until real per-stage values are supplied — revisit then.

CATCH_RECORD_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Catch Recording Service (catch-record lifecycle + vessel favourites API, see ADR-0025) for this stage. Required: false until the backend team confirms a real per-stage address — revisit then. Deliberately a separate key from API_BASE_URL (the reference-data service's own address).

ENTRA_API_SCOPE.description: The Entra External ID scope (API permission) the app requests to call the Catch Recording Service, e.g. "api://<catch-record-service-app-id>/catch-recording.write" (see ADR-0022 addendum, ADR-0025). Required: false until the Entra tenant team registers the service and supplies a real scope — revisit then.
